purpose: Fresh text-only, role-specific front anchors for a matched three-view/four-view QuadView LoRA stability comparison. No image reference is connected in this stage.

parameters.style_prompt: original Midjourney-inspired fantasy character concept art, detailed painterly game illustration, polished material rendering, clear readable design
parameters.composition_prompt: One character only, full-body front view, standing neutrally with arms relaxed, character occupies about 78 percent of the canvas height, generous empty space above the head and below both feet, keep every carried weapon and signature item fully inside the frame with visible margins, centered on a clean warm-gray studio background, soft even studio light, crisp silhouette, no cropping, no text, no watermark, no extra characters.

cases.character_prompt: An adult woman swordswoman with a distinct heart-shaped face, almond-shaped dark-brown eyes, straight brows, and a calm focused expression. Glossy black hair in a high ponytail bound with red silk cord, two cheek-length locks, a decorative comb visible behind the head. Ivory wrapped tunic, deep-navy split riding coat with red lining, layered pleated waist panels, lacquered black shoulder guard, red sash, dark fitted trousers, black reinforced boots. Jade waist charm, red sleeve knots, silver collar crest, long katana in a black lacquer scabbard at the left hip and a short utility blade at the back waist.

An adult woman battle mage with a distinct oval face, warm freckled skin, green-hazel eyes, and a composed expression. Copper-red hair in a high braided ponytail, three thin temple braids and loose jaw-length curls. Ivory high-collar blouse, burgundy velvet waistcoat, long asymmetrical wine-red coat with split tails and embroidered cuffs, charcoal pleated trousers, dark knee boots, narrow brass shoulder plates, wide leather belt with potion loops. Cobalt crystal pendant at the sternum, brass rings on the right hand, red belt tassel, carved ash staff topped with a blue glass orb and a small spellbook pouch at the left hip.

An adult male dwarf engineer, short and broad-shouldered, with a square weathered face, hazel eyes, a thick copper-brown braided beard, and a leather work cap with round brass goggles pushed above his eyes. He wears a moss-green canvas jacket over a cream shirt, a dark leather apron with tool loops, sturdy brown trousers, and steel-toed boots. Signature equipment: a compact brass-and-steel wrench in his right hand, a tool roll at his belt, and a small copper gear-shaped pack on his back. Keep his beard, cap, goggles, apron and tools clearly readable.

A tall adult humanoid lizard warrior with turquoise-green scales, a long narrow reptilian muzzle, amber slit-pupil eyes, two swept-back ivory horns, and a thick scaled tail. He wears a dark teal leather cuirass, bronze shoulder plates, a rust-red waist sash, layered scale skirt, dark greaves and sandals. Signature equipment: a long black spear with a bronze head carried in one hand and a round bronze shield strapped to the other arm. Preserve the same horn shape, scale colors, armor, spear, shield and tail in the full-body design.

A tall adult humanoid lizard warrior with turquoise-green scales, a long narrow reptilian muzzle, amber slit-pupil eyes, two swept-back ivory horns, and a thick scaled tail. He wears a dark teal leather cuirass, bronze shoulder plates, a rust-red waist sash, layered scale skirt, dark greaves and sandals. Signature equipment: a long black spear with a bronze head carried in one hand and a round bronze shield strapped to the other arm. Pose him squarely front-facing from head to feet: head, chest, hips and toes point straight at the camera, both eyes and both horns visible symmetrically. Keep the spear upright beside him and the shield on his other arm. Do not turn his head or torso to three-quarter view.
